episodes.title: Wheel of Fire
episodes.summary: After renowned actor Arthur Leander tragically collapses onstage, Jeevan Chaudhary and young Kirsten Raymonde have a chance meeting – and soon face an important decision that could save their lives.

episodes.title: A Hawk from a Handsaw
episodes.summary: Twenty years later, Kirsten and her Shakespearean troupe, the Traveling Symphony, meet a mysterious man on their way to perform at St. Deborah-by-the-Water.

episodes.title: Hurricane
episodes.summary: While fighting for her only chance at survival, Miranda Carroll reflects on the cost of her relationships with Arthur and Dr. Eleven.

episodes.title: Rosencrantz and Guildenstern Aren't Dead
episodes.summary: After Kirsten nudges the Traveling Symphony off-course to help unravel the mystery of the Prophet, a much grimmer truth is revealed.

episodes.title: The Severn City Airport
episodes.summary: After an unexpected landing in Severn City, Arthur's ex-wife Elizabeth, son Tyler, and friend Clark confront an even more uncertain future.

episodes.title: Survival is Insufficient
episodes.summary: While Kirsten leaves the Traveling Symphony behind to track down the Prophet, the Conductor accepts an invitation for the rest of the grieving troupe that breaks her heart.

episodes.title: Goodbye My Damaged Home
episodes.summary: On a journey to unravel her deepest trauma, Kirsten goes back to the apartment she once shared with Jeevan and Frank.

episodes.title: Who's There?
episodes.summary: Kirsten arrives in Severn City to rescue the Traveling Symphony – only to find herself trapped in a family conflict that began twenty years ago.

episodes.title: Dr. Chaudhary
episodes.summary: Jeevan and Kirsten survive their first winter alone, until an argument sends Jeevan on an unexpected path.

episodes.title: Unbroken Circle
episodes.summary: Kirsten sets in motion her plan to free the Traveling Symphony, while Miranda tries to live the right life.
